d: The OCC crew steps into the high-speed world of NASCAR, meeting racing fans, exploring the pit areas and soaking up the excitement of stock car racing. But the real challenge begins when they bring that racing inspiration back to the workshop for a custom motorcycle build. With bold design ideas and a demanding deadline, Paul Sr., Paul Jr. and the crew have plenty to keep them busy. Watch American Chopper Season 3 Episode 70 only on discovery+ India.
